primitive.$description: Raw foundational values - not for direct use in code, referenced by applied tokens

theme.$description: Theme colors with agency mode variations

faint.$description: Faintest theme tint. USE for subtle backgrounds and hover states.

weaker.$description: Very light theme tint. USE for secondary backgrounds and disabled states.

weak.$description: Light theme tint. USE for borders and light accent backgrounds.

mid.$description: Mid-range theme color. USE for secondary buttons and active states.

default.$description: Primary theme color. USE for primary buttons, links, and key UI accents.

strong.$description: Dark theme variant. USE for hover states on primary elements.

stronger.$description: Darkest theme variant. USE for active/pressed states on primary elements.

applied.$description: Semantic tokens for use in code - reference these, not primitives

accent.$description: Accent color for highlights and emphasis. USE sparingly for visual interest.

default.$description: Default base color for UI elements. USE for borders and dividers.

weak.$description: Subtle base color. USE for hover states and subtle backgrounds.

default.$description: Success state indicator. USE for confirmations and positive feedback. MUST pair with success icon.

strong.$description: Strong success emphasis. USE for success text on light backgrounds.

weak.$description: Success background tint. USE for success alert backgrounds.

default.$description: Informational state. USE for neutral notifications and tips.

strong.$description: Strong info emphasis. USE for info text on light backgrounds.

weak.$description: Info background tint. USE for info alert backgrounds.

default.$description: Warning state. USE for cautions that need attention. SHOULD pair with warning icon.

strong.$description: Strong warning emphasis. USE for warning text on light backgrounds.

weak.$description: Warning background tint. USE for warning alert backgrounds.

default.$description: Danger/error state. USE for errors and destructive actions. MUST pair with error message.

strong.$description: Strong danger emphasis. USE for error text on light backgrounds.

weak.$description: Danger background tint. USE for error alert backgrounds.

default.$description: Emergency banner color. USE only for critical system-wide alerts.

weak.$description: Emergency accent. USE for emergency banner highlights.

default.$description: Primary ink color. USE for icons and graphic elements.

reverse.$description: Reverse ink for dark backgrounds. USE for icons on dark surfaces.

default.$description: Primary text color. USE for body copy and headings. MUST meet WCAG 4.5:1 contrast.

weak.$description: Secondary text. USE for metadata, captions, and supporting content.

weaker.$description: Tertiary text. USE for placeholder text and subtle labels. AVOID for important content.

weakest.$description: Decorative text only. AVOID for readable content - insufficient contrast.

disabled.$description: Disabled text state. USE only for disabled form elements.

reverse.$description: Primary text on dark backgrounds. MUST use with surface-reverse.

reverse-weak.$description: Secondary text on dark backgrounds. USE for metadata on dark surfaces.

reverse-weaker.$description: Tertiary text on dark backgrounds. USE for subtle content on dark surfaces.

reverse-disabled.$description: Disabled text on dark backgrounds. USE only for disabled elements on dark surfaces.

default.$description: Default link color. MUST be distinguishable from body text. USE for inline links.

strong.$description: Visited or hover link state. USE for :visited and :hover states.

strongest.$description: Active link state. USE for :active state on links.

neutral.$description: Neutral link style. USE when link styling should match body text color.

reverse.$description: Link on dark background. USE for links on dark surfaces.

reverse-strong.$description: Hover link on dark background. USE for :hover on dark surfaces.

reverse-strongest.$description: Active link on dark background. USE for :active on dark surfaces.

reverse-neutral.$description: Neutral link on dark background. USE for neutral links on dark surfaces.

default.$description: Default page background. USE for main content areas and cards.

reverse.$description: Dark surface background. USE for dark mode sections and footers.

raised.$description: Elevated surface background. USE for cards and raised elements.

focus.$description: Focus ring color. MUST be visible on all backgrounds. USE for :focus-visible outlines.

focus-reverse.$description: Focus ring color on dark backgrounds. USE for :focus-visible outlines on dark surfaces.

space.$description: Spacing tokens for margins, padding, and gaps

size.$description: Size tokens for widths, heights, and dimensions

agency.$description: Agency branding font family. USE for agency-specific branded text elements.

body.$description: Body text font family. USE for paragraphs and running text. PREFER over --nys-font-family-sans.

display.$description: Display font family. USE for hero text and large decorative headings. PREFER over --nys-font-family-sans.

ui.$description: UI font family. USE for buttons, labels, and form elements. PREFER over --nys-font-family-sans.

heading.$description: Heading font family. USE for h1–h6 headings. PREFER over --nys-font-family-sans.

body-xs.$description: Body text size (extra-small). USE for captions and fine print.

body-sm.$description: Body text size (small). USE for secondary text and metadata.

body-md.$description: Body text size (medium). USE for default paragraph and running text.

body-lg.$description: Body text size (large). USE for lead paragraphs and emphasized body text.

h1.$description: Heading 1 size. USE for primary page headings.

h2.$description: Heading 2 size. USE for section headings.

h3.$description: Heading 3 size. USE for subsection headings.

h4.$description: Heading 4 size. USE for minor headings.

h5.$description: Heading 5 size. USE for minor headings.

h6.$description: Heading 6 size. USE for minor headings.

ui-xs.$description: UI element size (extra-small). USE for small labels and badges.

ui-sm.$description: UI element size (small). USE for compact buttons and form controls.

ui-md.$description: UI element size (medium). USE for default buttons, labels, and form controls.

ui-lg.$description: UI element size (large). USE for prominent buttons and form controls.

ui-xl.$description: UI element size (extra-large). USE for large interactive elements.

display-sm.$description: Display text size (small). USE for hero banners and decorative headings.

display-md.$description: Display text size (medium). USE for hero banners and decorative headings.

display-lg.$description: Display text size (large). USE for hero banners and decorative headings.

display-xl.$description: Display text size (extra-large). USE for hero banners and decorative headings.

agency-md.$description: Agency branding text size (medium). USE for agency-specific branded elements.

agency-lg.$description: Agency branding text size (large). USE for agency-specific branded elements.

agency-xl.$description: Agency branding text size (extra-large). USE for agency-specific branded elements.
